tEn: Building Visual Intelligence: Inside Black Forest Labs
tZh: 构建视觉智能：走进黑森林实验室
sEn: Andreas Blattmann of Black Forest Labs traces the path from Latent Diffusion to Flux and the frontier of visual intelligence.
sZh: 黑森林实验室的 Andreas Blattmann 讲述从潜在扩散到 Flux 的历程，以及视觉智能的前沿探索。

consensus.en: Visual intelligence from 2D video data implicitly learns 3D world understanding, enabling fast fine-tuning for 3D tasks.
consensus.zh: 从2D视频数据中学习的视觉智能隐含了3D世界理解，能够快速微调用于3D任务。

consensus.en: Data quality and filtering are as critical as algorithms; the right data distribution determines model capability.
consensus.zh: 数据质量和过滤与算法同样关键；正确的数据分布决定模型能力。

consensus.en: Flow matching simplifies diffusion mathematically, is more general, and enables faster sampling.
consensus.zh: 流匹配在数学上简化了扩散，更通用，并支持更快的采样。

consensus.en: Flux Context solved character-consistent editing by leveraging pre-trained spatial relationships with minimal training.
consensus.zh: Flux Context通过利用预训练的空间关系，以最少训练解决了角色一致性编辑问题。

consensus.en: Robotics will see major commercial applications in manufacturing by 2027, driven by general world models.
consensus.zh: 在通用世界模型的驱动下，机器人技术将在2027年前在制造业实现重大商业应用。

consensus.en: Autoregressive models are more data-efficient for training, but diffusion models allow faster sampling via distillation.
consensus.zh: 自回归模型在训练时数据效率更高，但扩散模型可通过蒸馏实现更快采样。

contrarian.en: You don't need explicit 3D modeling; learning from 2D video data suffices for world understanding.
contrarian.zh: 你不需要显式的3D建模；从2D视频数据中学习就足以获得世界理解。

contrarian.en: The debate between autoregressive and diffusion for image generation is not settled; both remain promising.
contrarian.zh: 自回归与扩散在图像生成上的争论尚未定论；两者都仍有前景。

contrarian.en: Public preference tuning like Midjourney's Discord loop offers limited signal once base models reach high quality.
contrarian.zh: 一旦基础模型达到高质量，像Midjourney的Discord循环这样的公开偏好调优提供的信号有限。

contrarian.en: Diffusion models can incorporate language capabilities; autoregressive is not required for conversational editing.
contrarian.zh: 扩散模型可以融入语言能力；对话式编辑并不需要自回归。

contrarian.en: In-context learning for robotics—showing a robot an action once—is the path to superhuman visual intelligence.
contrarian.zh: 机器人技术的上下文学习——向机器人展示一次动作——是通向超人类视觉智能的路径。

contrarian.en: Scaling is almost always the most effective approach, but compute should be spent efficiently where it matters.
contrarian.zh: Scaling几乎总是最有效的方法，但算力应高效地花在关键之处。

turns.en: And instead of approaching this problem to transform one probability distribution into the other by seeing it as a solution of a stochastic differential equation, you're actually seeing it as a solution of an ordinary differential equation, which simplifies everything completely, mathematically completely, and makes fast sampling much more feasible. Because what we always do when we have trained the model is we want to make as few steps as possible to sample as fast as possible, right? Some people would say it's actually a special case of diffusion, flow matching. Others might say it's a generalization of flow matching of diffusion, the flow matching algorithm, because you can translate between two distributions no matter how they are shaped, and you don't need this standard normal to be one of them. But in general it can be seen as a model that learns a vector field between two distributions that translates between them. And once the model has learned that vector field, you can just integrate it numerically, which is as easy as solving an ODE by means of an Euler forward step. So it's very similar in many respects. But it was mathematically easier, more general from the kinds of probability distributions that it can translate between. That's why we went with it. And maybe as a third party said, it's also easier to derive a fast model from those flow matching models.
turns.zh: 与其把这个问题看作将一个概率分布转换为另一个概率分布，并将其视为随机微分方程的解，不如将其视为常微分方程的解，这在数学上完全简化了一切，也使快速采样更加可行。因为当我们训练好模型后，总是希望用尽可能少的步骤来尽快采样，对吧？有些人会说它实际上是扩散模型的一个特例，即流匹配。其他人可能会说它实际上是流匹配的推广，是扩散的推广，即流匹配算法，因为你可以在两个分布之间进行转换，无论它们形状如何，而且你不需要标准正态分布作为其中之一。但总的来说，它可以被视为一个学习两个分布之间向量场的模型，该向量场在它们之间进行转换。一旦模型学会了那个向量场，你就可以用数值方法积分它，这就像通过欧拉前向步骤求解常微分方程一样简单。所以在许多方面它非常相似。但它在数学上更容易，对于它可以转换的概率分布类型更通用。这就是我们选择它的原因。也许正如第三方所说，从这些流匹配模型中推导出快速模型也更容易。

And my theory in mind at the time was that since the model already has all of this spatial knowledge, if we essentially build the right data and train the model—train an already pre-trained model the right way—we should be able to evoke general image editing with very, very little training, capturing these already pre-built relationships of when things are there, when they're not there, and how these spatial relationships inside of an image work. tldr.en: Visual intelligence learned from 2D video implicitly captures 3D world understanding, enabling fast fine-tuning for 3D tasks.
tldr.zh: 从 2D 视频中学到的视觉智能隐含了 3D 世界理解，可快速微调用于 3D 任务。

tldr.en: Data quality and distribution are as critical as algorithms; flow matching simplifies diffusion and enables faster sampling.
tldr.zh: 数据质量和分布与算法同等关键；流匹配简化了扩散模型并实现更快采样。

tldr.en: Robotics will see major commercial applications in manufacturing by 2027, driven by general world models.
tldr.zh: 在通用世界模型的驱动下，机器人技术将在 2027 年前在制造业实现大规模商业应用。
